title: Daily-Frequency Convertible-Bond Multi-Factor and Tradable-Portfolio Research Based on the Orient Securities Framework
research_questions: Do daily valuation, underlying-equity, stock-bond linkage, and bond-trading factors provide stable out-of-sample cross-sectional information?
Do relative-valuation and state-adjusted extensions add evidence beyond the reference-report baselines?
Does incremental factor evidence survive realistic execution timing, trading constraints, turnover, and costs?

source_roles.convertible_bond_terms: Point-in-time convertible-bond terms and security master
source_roles.point_in_time_events: Point-in-time rating, conversion-term, balance, and redemption events
source_roles.underlying_stock_daily: Licensed A-share daily market and adjustment data
source_roles.intraday_data: Optional intraday market data reserved for separate extensions

data.secrets_policy: Credentials must be supplied through environment variables and must not be stored in configuration, source code, or notebooks

universe.mother_universe: Intersection of ordinary convertible bonds in the point-in-time security master and bonds with observed daily market data from 2018 onward

factor_scope.extension_rule: Each extension must document its incremental conditions, economic rationale, and out-of-sample evidence relative to the reference-report baseline

conversion_premium.rationale: Preserve the full parity-dependent convertible-bond valuation structure.

double_low.rationale: Preserve the intended joint price and conversion-premium signal.

relative_premium_to_parity_median.rationale: Parity is controlled by construction; remove residual balance, credit, and maturity exposures.

parity_value_score.rationale: Process the direction-reversed audit counterpart consistently; retain only one version during redundancy selection.

stock_return_5d.rationale: Remove broad industry and underlying-equity size exposures from the short-horizon stock return signal.

stock_return_10d.rationale: Remove broad industry and underlying-equity size exposures from the medium-horizon stock return signal.

stock_return_20d.rationale: Remove broad industry and underlying-equity size exposures from the monthly stock return signal.

stock_volatility_20d.rationale: Measure stock volatility beyond systematic industry and company-size effects.

stock_rsi_20d.rationale: Measure stock price strength beyond systematic industry and company-size effects.

stock_price_to_high_20d.rationale: Measure proximity to the recent high beyond systematic industry and company-size effects.

stock_percent_b_20d.rationale: Measure Bollinger-band position beyond systematic industry and company-size effects.

stock_amihud_20d.rationale: Separate stock illiquidity from its mechanical industry and company-size exposures.

stock_mfi_20d.rationale: Measure volume-weighted stock buying pressure beyond systematic industry and company-size effects.

stages.name: Valuation Coordinate System and Foundation Factors

pending_decisions: Industry, balance, rating, and maturity neutralization by factor family
TOP-N portfolio size and bond-type balancing rule
Historical trading-capacity threshold and order participation rate
Boundary between linear factor combinations and Ridge or Elastic Net as the primary model
Second-stage total-return treatment for coupons, puts, and special delistings
